name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Picks exactly one option from a short list, as classic radios or as selectable cards with a title and description.

examples.name: radio-group-cards
examples.title: Cards
examples.description: variant="card": the whole card is the target; the description is linked, not part of the name.

examples.name: radio-group-cards-horizontal
examples.title: Cards in a row
examples.description: Wraps to a column on narrow screens.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the group label.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown with an icon when invalid.

props.name: variant
props.description: card renders each Radio as a selectable card (title = children, plus description).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout. Horizontal cards share the row and wrap when narrow.

props.name: children
props.description: The label (the card title in the card variant).

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables this option; arrow keys skip it.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the selected radio (or the first), then out of the group.
Move to and select the next/previous option, skipping disabled ones.
Selects the focused radio if nothing is selected.

notes: Uses native radio inputs inside a radiogroup.
In the card variant the label stretches over the card, so the whole card is clickable, and the focus ring is drawn around the card.
Selected cards get a 2px primary edge and a tinted fill, not colour alone.

do: Use for 2–6 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible.
Use cards when each option needs a sentence of explanation (fees, timing).
Preselect a sensible default when there is one.
dont: Don't use radios for more than about 7 options; use a Select.
Don't put interactive elements inside a card; the whole card is the target.
